assessments.reasoning: The pinned Scope section explicitly limits refinement activation to the lexical scope after using is called. It gives the end of the current class or module definition, or the end of the current file for top-level use, and separately describes eval strings.

challenge.method: Check code lexically before and after a successful using call, activation from top level and a class body, reopening a class, an unexecuted call, and the eval exception.
challenge.results: The examples preserve the lexical and executed-call conditions. The file and definition end bounds match the statement. A later reopening or dynamic caller does not activate the same refinement by itself, and eval has its own boundary.

limitations: This is the source guide's ordinary top-level and class/module rule. Method bodies may use refinements in force where the method was defined, and eval has separate handling.
